runtime_uncertainties: Original official device authority, content, designation and erection sources remain unobserved.
Original map identity, hazardous or congested physical facts, route and stop targets remain unobserved.
Six exact stop, stand and park draft offline constructions pass, but none is selected delivery or physically executed.
Selected-case source-bound compatibility, saved processing, semantic proposals, independent delivery/comparison audits, and physical lifecycle proofs remain.
Original purpose, attendance, passenger and merchandise activity needed to distinguish stopping, standing and parking remain unobserved.
Legal characterization of hazardous or congested place remains unresolved.

dev.regulatory_sign.evidence: Original official device content, authority source and erection interval are hash-bound in original-device.json and original-review.json; CPU fixture only proves rejection behavior.

dev.governs.evidence: Original designation polygon source is independently hash-bound in original-designation.json and original-review.json; device pose alone is insufficient.

drv.standing_or_parked.evidence: Original 20 Hz frame-linked body, speed and reviewed person activity are required to distinguish requested stop, stand and park; fixture mode is not evidence.

rel.occupies.evidence: Original body footprint at rest is intersected with the independently sourced designated polygon for all 600 frames.

dev.position.evidence: Original device map placement and independently sourced designated polygon are retained separately; no legal extent inferred from pose.

legal_analysis_note: Exact statute retained. Witnesses and recovered summaries are unreviewed where marked. Conditions, alternatives and exceptions in source_topic_inventory require separate physical scoping before delivery selection.
